crossRefs.note: Edom shall be a possession. Seir, his enemies, also shall be a possession, while Israel does valiantly.
Yahweh makes poor and makes rich. He brings low, he also lifts up.
He raises up the poor out of the dust. He lifts up the needy from the dunghill to make them sit with princes and…
Therefore he takes knowledge of their works. He overturns them in the night, so that they are destroyed.
Again, they are diminished and bowed down through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.
He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.
Yahweh of Armies has planned it, to stain the pride of all glory, to bring into contempt all the honorable of the earth.
It will be the lowest of the kingdoms. It won’t lift itself up above the nations any more. I will diminish them, so…
Then my enemy will see it, and shame will cover her who said to me, where is Yahweh your God? Then my enemy will see me…
He has shown strength with his arm. He has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
He has put down princes from their thrones, and has exalted the lowly.

parallels.note: “For, behold, I have made you small among the nations, and despised among men.

translations.web: Behold, I have made you small among the nations. You are greatly despised.
translations.bsb: “Behold, I will make you small among the nations; you will be deeply despised.
translations.kjv: Behold, I have made thee small among the heathen: thou art greatly despised.
translations.asv: Behold, I have made thee small among the nations: thou art greatly despised.
